Command `cd /workspace && cat > /workspace/candidate_trace.json <<'EOF'
[
  {"step": 1, "file": "h3_fuzzer.c", "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput", "line": 36, "var": "new_str", "code": "memcpy(new_str, data, size);", "note": "Attacker-controlled input bytes are copied into a NUL-terminated string buffer."},
  {"step": 2, "file": "h3_fuzzer.c", "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput", "line": 40, "var": "h3", "code": "h3 = H3_EXPORT(stringToH3)(new_str);", "note": "The hex string '08101c0000000000' is parsed into H3 index 0x08101c0000000000, whose resolution-1 digit is 7 (INVALID_DIGIT)."},
  {"step": 3, "file": "h3_fuzzer.c", "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput", "line": 71, "var": "h3", "code": "h3NeighborRotations(h3, DIGITS[i], &rotations);", "note": "The crafted H3 index is passed to h3NeighborRotations in a loop; the invalid digit 7 is carried into the neighbor-rotation logic."},
  {"step": 4, "file": "src/h3lib/lib/algos.c", "function": "h3NeighborRotations", "line": 347, "var": "oldDigit", "code": "Direction oldDigit = H3_GET_INDEX_DIGIT(out, r + 1);", "note": "Reads the resolution-1 digit of the crafted index, yielding oldDigit == 7 (INVALID_DIGIT), which is not a valid direction."},
  {"step": 5, "file": "src/h3lib/lib/algos.c", "function": "h3NeighborRotations", "line": 350, "var": "NEW_DIGIT_II[oldDigit][dir]", "code": "H3_SET_INDEX_DIGIT(out, r + 1, NEW_DIGIT_II[oldDigit][dir]);", "note": "NEW_DIGIT_II is a [7][7] array; indexing with oldDigit==7 reads out of bounds, triggering the UBSan index-out-of-bounds error."},
  {"step": 6, "file": "src/h3lib/lib/algos.c", "function": "h3NeighborRotations", "line": 351, "var": "NEW_ADJUSTMENT_II[oldDigit][dir]", "code": "nextDir = NEW_ADJUSTMENT_II[oldDigit][dir];", "note": "NEW_ADJUSTMENT_II is also a [7][7] array; indexing with oldDigit==7 reads out of bounds, confirming the memory-safety violation."}
]
EOF
python3 -c "import json; json.load(open('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')); print('valid JSON')"` executed with exit code 0.
